description: This file defines an abstract class AbstractAuthRpcHandler that manages authentication for RPC calls in the Spark network server. It delegates calls to another RpcHandler after successful authentication.

classes.name: AbstractAuthRpcHandler
classes.description: An abstract class that handles authentication for RPC calls and delegates to another RpcHandler upon successful authentication.

methods.name: doAuthChallenge
methods.description: Abstract method to respond to an authentication challenge, implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Handles incoming messages; delegates if authenticated, otherwise performs authentication challenge.

methods.name: receive
methods.description: Handles incoming messages without callback; throws exception if unauthenticated.

methods.name: receiveStream
methods.description: Handles streaming messages; delegates if authenticated, otherwise throws exception.

methods.name: getStreamManager
methods.description: Returns the stream manager from the delegate.

methods.name: getMergedBlockMetaReqHandler
methods.description: Returns the merged block meta request handler from the delegate.
